meta.name: WealthSmith Primitive Spacing Tokens
meta.description: Raw spacing values for the WealthSmith design system. WealthSmith follows an 8px spacing system by default, with smaller 4px increments available for fine UI adjustments.

1.description: Micro spacing for tight UI details, icon alignment, and focus offsets

3.description: Compact spacing for dense UI when 8px is too tight and 16px is too large

4.description: Default compact spacing and mobile page padding

6.description: Section/group spacing and tablet page padding

7.description: Large spacing and default desktop page padding

10.description: Extra-large section spacing and wide-layout margin

13.description: Maximum page-level spacing for large layouts
